'''Viewpointe Residential Tower''' was an upscale, 20-story building located in the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Glare Peak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Trivar II]]. The building, which was run by a [[Chief Superintendent|Chief Superindendent]], overlooked the [[Trivar II Imperial Detention Center]] and was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives as a site for a [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] that they would use to spy on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rescue at Glare Peak" />
